src: With a data subset including 80% of patients from Sao Paulo (SP) and Rio Janeiro (RJ), we obtained a function which reached an AUC of 95.54% (95% CI: 94.41-96.67%) for the diagnosis of COVID-19 and accuracy of 90.1% (sensitivity 87.62% and specificity 92.02%).
tgt: Avec un sous-ensemble de données incluant 80% des patients de sao paulo (sp) et rio janeiro (rj), nous avons obtenu une fonction qui a atteint une auc de 95,54% (ic à 95%: 94,41-96,67%) pour le diagnostic de Covid-19 et une précision de 90,1% (sensibilité 87,62% et spécificité 92,02%).
ref: Avec un sous-ensemble de données incluant 80 % de patients de Sao Paulo (SP) et de Rio Janeiro (RJ), nous avons obtenu une fonction qui a atteint une ASC de 95,54 % (IC à 95 % : 94,41 à 96,67 %) pour le diagnostic de la COVID-19 et une précision de 90,1 % (sensibilité 87,62 % et spécificité 92,02 %).

Avec un sous-ensemble de données incluant 80 % de patients de Sao Paulo (SP) et de Rio Janeiro (RJ), nous avons obtenu une fonction qui a atteint une ASC de 95,54 % (IC à 95 % : 94,41 à 96,67 %) pour le diagnostic de la COVID-19 et une précision de 90,1 % (sensibilité 87,62 % et spécificité 92,02 %).
bt_tgt: With a subset of data including 80% of Sao Paulo (sp) and Rio Janeiro (rj) patients, we obtained a function that achieved a 95.54% (IC at 95%: 94.41-96.67%) accuracy for the diagnosis of Covid-19 and a 90.1% accuracy (87.62% sensitivity and 92.02% specificity).

src: We obtained a model suitable for the clinical diagnosis of COVID-19 based on routinely collected surveillance data.

src: The classical immunosuppressive treatment of systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease is evolving, as recent studies suggest a beneficial effect of biological agents such as rituximab and tocilizumab, and antifibrotic drugs such as nintedanib.

src: Digital prosthodontic technology has brought great changes to the prosthodontic technology in China by improving the quality of prostheses, adding new types of restorations, changing the manufacturing methods of restorations from handmade to computer-aided manufacturing, bringing new operating models of dental laboratories, and promoting the academic status of the prosthodontic technology.

ref: 流感病毒感染是一种呼吸道传染病，会严重影响人类健康。
流感病毒感染是一种呼吸道传染病，会严重影响人类健康。
bt_tgt: Influenza virus infection is a respiratory infectious disease that seriously affects human health.

src: Influenza viruses can have frequent antigenic variation and changes, which can result in rapid and widespread transmission resulting in annual epidemics and outbreaks in places of public gathering such as schools, kindergartens and nursing homes.
tgt: 流感病毒可具有频繁的抗原变异和变化，这可导致快速和广泛的传播，导致每年流行，并在学校、幼儿园和疗养院等公众聚集场所爆发。
ref: 流感病毒可发生频繁的抗原变异和变化，这使其快速和广泛的传播，这导致每年在学校、幼儿园和养老院等公共集会场所爆发流行病和疫情。
流感病毒可发生频繁的抗原变异和变化，这使其快速和广泛的传播，导致每年在学校、幼儿园和养老院等公共集会场所爆发流行病和疫情。
bt_tgt: Influenza viruses can have frequent antigen variations and variations, which can cause rapid and widespread transmission, result in annual outbreaks, and outbreaks in public gathering places such as schools, kindergartens, and nursing homes.

src: Pregnant women, young children, the elderly, and persons with chronic illnesses are at high risk for severe illness and death associated with influenza virus infection.
tgt: 孕妇、幼儿、老年人和慢性病患者患与流感病毒感染相关的重症和死亡的风险很高。
ref: 孕妇、幼儿、老人和慢性病患者是感染流感病毒的高风险人群，他们极有可能感染严重疾病、死亡。
孕妇、幼儿、老人和慢性病患者是感染流感病毒的高风险人群，他们极有可能感染严重疾病和死亡。
bt_tgt: Pregnant women, infants, the elderly, and patients with chronic illnesses are at high risk of serious illness and death associated with influenza viruses.

src: Especially, COVID-19 pandemic might co-circulate with other respiratory infectious diseases such as influenza in the coming winter-spring season.
tgt: 特别是，在即将到来的冬春季节，COVID-19大流行可能与流感等其他呼吸道传染病共同传播。
ref: 特别是，在即将到来的冬春季节，COVID-19 大流行可能会与流感等其他呼吸道传染病共同传播。
特别是，在即将到来的冬春季节，COVID-19 大流行可能会与其他呼吸道传染病如流感等共同传播。
bt_tgt: In particular, during the coming winter and spring, the COVID-19 pandemic may spread alongside other respiratory infectious diseases such as influenza.

src: Seasonal influenza vaccination is the most effective way to prevent influenza virus infection and complications from infection.
tgt: 季节性流感疫苗接种是预防流感病毒感染和感染并发症的最有效方法。
bt_tgt: Seasonal flu vaccination is the most effective way to prevent influenza virus infection and complications of infection.

src: Except for a few major cities, influenza vaccine is a category Ⅱ vaccine, which means influenza vaccination is voluntary, and recipients must pay for it.
tgt: 除个别大城市外，流感疫苗都是二类疫苗，也就是说流感疫苗是自愿接种的，受种者必须自费。
ref: 除少数大城市外，流感疫苗属于二类疫苗，即自愿接种流感疫苗，且接种者必须付费。

bt_tgt: Apart from the individual major cities, the flu vaccine is a secondary vaccine, i.e. the flu vaccine is voluntary, so the recipient must pay for it.

src: In 2018 and 2019, the China CDC issued the "Technical Guidelines for Seasonal Influenza Vaccination in China" .
tgt: 2018年和2019年，中国疾控中心分别发布了《中国季节性流感疫苗接种技术指南》。

bt_tgt: In 2018 and 2019, respectively, the China Center for Disease Control released a Chinese seasonal flu vaccination technology guide.

src: In the past year, new research evidences home and abroad have been published, and new seasonal influenza vaccine has been licensed in China.

bt_tgt: Over the past year, new research evidence has been published at home and abroad, and a new seasonal flu vaccine has been licensed in China.

src: To strengthen the technical guidance for prevention and control of influenza and operational research on influenza vaccination in China, the National Immunization Advisory Committee (NIAC) Influenza Vaccination Technical Working Group (TWG), updated the 2019-2020 technical guidelines and compiled the "Technical guidelines for seasonal influenza vaccination in China (2020-2021)" .

src: Children aged 6 months through 8 years require 2 doses of influenza vaccine administered a minimum of 4 weeks apart during their first season of vaccination for optimal protection.

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.

src: There has been a sharp rise of reported handheld laser-induced maculopathy (HLIM) cases over the past decade, a concerning trend that may continue due to unregulated online access to high power lasers.

src: The present systematic review examined post-migration variables impacting upon mental health outcomes among asylum-seeking and refugee populations in Europe.

src: It focuses on the effects of post-settlement stressors (including length of asylum process and duration of stay, residency status and social integration) and their impact upon post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety and depression.
tgt: Se centra en los efectos de los estresores postasentamiento (incluyendo la duración del proceso de asilo, la duración de la estancia, la residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.
ref: Se centra en los efectos de los factores estresantes posteriores al asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.

src: Length of asylum process and duration of stay was found to be the most frequently cited factor for mental health difficulties in 9 out of 22 studies.

src: Contrary to expectation, residency or legal status was posited as a marker for other explanatory variables, including loneliness, discrimination and communication or language problems, rather than being an explanatory variable itself.

src: However, in line with previous findings and as hypothesised in this review, there were statistically significant correlations found between family life, family separation and mental health outcomes.

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.
tgt: El estudio pretendía comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (países) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.

src: The data were obtained from the Mortality Information System of the Brazilian Ministry of Health, from 2007 to 2016, and municipal indicators were from IBGE.

src: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).
tgt: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios que se analizaron, el Banco Mundial clasificó 130 (65,66 %) correctamente y el IBGE 183 (82,06 %).
ref: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios analizados, el Banco Mundial clasificó correctamente a 130 (65,66 %) y el IBGE, a 183 (82,06 %).
bt_tgt: The World Bank's definition of rural areas showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank ranked 130 (65.66%) correctly and the IBGE 183 (82.06%) correctly.

src: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities in Paraiba state was male gender (57.4%), brown skin color (61.1%), age from 0 to 7 days (52.4%), low birthweight (44%), and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2%).
tgt: El perfil epidemiológico predominante de la mortalidad infantil en los municipios rurales del estado de Paraiba fue el sexo masculino (57,4 %), el color marrón de la piel (61,1 %), la edad de 0 a 7 días (52,4 %), el bajo peso al nacer (44 %) y la edad gestacional inferior a 37 semanas (43,2 %).
bt_tgt: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in the rural municipalities of Paraiba state was male (57.4 percent), brown skin (61.1 percent), age 0 to 7 days (52.4 percent), low birth weight (44 percent) and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2 percent).

src: Underlying cause of death was classified as avoidable death via interventions by the Brazilian Unified National Health System (65.2%).

src: It was also necessary to modify several protocols and circuits, especially for the management of early discharges from maternity centres, and for the collection of the necessary second samples (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low quality samples).

src: In general, a 36% reduction in the time of arrival of these second samples at the laboratory was achieved with respect to the previous circuit.

src: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100% reduction in the request for second samples and a 70% reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.
tgt: El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de municipios (países) rurales del estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio de ruralidad.
ref: El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.

El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.
bt_tgt: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rural life, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which one best fits the reality of the territory, as well as to analyze the profile of child mortality in rural municipalities (countries) of the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion of rural life.

src: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).
tgt: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0.337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0.616. Entre los 223 municipios que fueron analizados, el Banco Mundial clasificó 130 (65.66%) correctamente, y la IBGE 183 (82.06%).

bt_tgt: The World Bank's definition of rural areas showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank ranked 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).

src: Faced with the prospect of a collapsed health system due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the professionals involved in the Neonatal Screening Programme (NSP) of Catalonia had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient manner.
tgt: Ante la perspectiva de un sistema de salud colapsado a raíz de la pandemia de Cyber-19, los profesionales que participan en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (PPN) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.
ref: Ante la perspectiva de un sistema de salud colapsado por la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP, por sus siglas en inglés) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.

bt_tgt: Faced with the prospect of a healthcare system collapsing in the wake of the Cyber-19 pandemic, professionals participating in Catalonia's Neonatal Screening Program (NCP) had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient manner.

src: The most important goals were to prevent the risk of infection in the professionals, in families and their newborns, as well as to ensure the same effectiveness for the early detection of the diseases included in our programme.
tgt: Los objetivos más importantes fueron prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como asegurar la misma efectividad para la detección precoz de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.
ref: Los objetivos más importantes eran prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como garantizar la misma eficacia para la detección precoz de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.
bt_tgt: The most important goals were to prevent the risk of infection in professionals, families and their newborns, as well as to ensure the same effectiveness for early detection of diseases included in our program.

src: To this end, the laboratory was reorganised by dividing the staff into groups and the spaces were redistributed.

src: In general, a 36% reduction in the time of arrival of these second samples at the laboratory was achieved with respect to the previous circuit.

src: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100% reduction in the request for second samples and a 70% reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.
tgt: En el caso concreto de la detección de fibrosis quística, la implementación de una nueva estrategia supuso una reducción del 100% en la solicitud de segundas muestras y de un 70% en la edad de diagnóstico del recién nacido.
ref: En el caso específico de la detección de fibrosis quística, la implementación de una nueva estrategia significó una reducción del 100 % en la solicitud de segundas muestras y una reducción del 70 % en la edad de diagnóstico del recién nacido.
bt_tgt: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy means a 100% reduction in the request for second samples and a 70% reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.

src: After evaluating these changes, it can be concluded that in the face of the pandemic, the NSP of Catalonia showed determined leadership, aligning all its professionals, ensuring the continuity of the activity in the programme and generating new opportunities.

bt_tgt: After assessing these changes, it can be concluded that in the face of the pandemic, the PNS of Catalonia has shown a determined leadership, aligning all its professionals, ensuring the continuity of activity in the program and generating new opportunities.

src: The new processes and circuits implemented have been definitively consolidated, improving the efficiency of the programme.

src: The present systematic review examined post-migration variables impacting upon mental health outcomes among asylum-seeking and refugee populations in Europe.
tgt: La presente revisión sistemática examinó las variables posteriores a la emigración que repercuten en los resultados de salud mental entre las poblaciones de refugiados y solicitantes de asilo en Europa.
ref: La presente revisión sistemática examinó las variables posteriores a la migración que afectan a los resultados de salud mental entre las poblaciones solicitantes de asilo y refugiadas en Europa.
bt_tgt: This systematic review examined the post-emigration variables that impact on mental health outcomes among refugee and asylum-seeker populations in Europe.

src: It focuses on the effects of post-settlement stressors (including length of asylum process and duration of stay, residency status and social integration) and their impact upon post-traumatic stress disorder, anxiety and depression.
tgt: Se centra en los efectos de los estresores post-asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto sobre el trastorno por estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.
ref: Se centra en los efectos de los factores estresantes posteriores al asentamiento (incluida la duración del proceso de asilo y la duración de la estancia, el estado de residencia y la integración social) y su impacto en el trastorno de estrés postraumático, la ansiedad y la depresión.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media de 12 años; DE de 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad de 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de su hijo (dependencia para el manejo de las necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto oftalmológico al hablar), frecuencia de participación y la CV. La regresión lineal entre los medios fue la gestión de la calidad de vida.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).
bt_tgt: The caregivers of 435 children (211 women, 224 men; average age 12 years; DE 3 years 11 months; age range 5-18 years) with intellectual disabilities and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence on personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), participation frequency and CV. Linear regression between the means was quality of life management.

src: Two indicators were analyzed: the outcome of the reference to general surgery, categorized as resolved, withdrawal and not resolved; and the time of solution of the surgical problem, which measures the median in calendar days from the issuance of the reference to the counter-reference for the reason of original sending.

bt_tgt: Two indicators were analyzed: the result of the reference to a general surgery, categorized as solved, withdrawn and unresolved; and the time of resolution of the surgical problem, which measures the median in calendar days from the date of issue of the reference to the counter-reference for the reason of the original shipment.

src: The 84.8% of cases were resolved in a median time of 72 days (50-112), 14.1% of patients reject surgery and 1% wasnot resolved.

src: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rurality, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which is better fitted to the territory's reality, besides analyzing the infant mortality profile of rural municipalities (counties) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rurality.
tgt: El estudio pretendía comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (países) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, de acuerdo con el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.
ref: El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.

El estudio tuvo como objetivo comparar dos conceptos de ruralidad, uno propuesto por el Instituto Brasileño de Geografía y Estadística (IBGE) y el otro por el Banco Mundial, para determinar cuál se ajusta mejor a la realidad del territorio, además de analizar el perfil de mortalidad infantil de los municipios rurales (condados) en el estado de Paraíba, Brasil, según el mejor criterio para la ruralidad.
bt_tgt: The study aimed to compare two concepts of rural life, one proposed by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and the other by the World Bank, to determine which one best fits the reality of the territory, in addition to analyzing the profile of child mortality in rural municipalities (países) in the state of Paraíba, Brazil, according to the best criterion for rural life.

src: This was an observational epidemiological study conducted in the state of Paraíba.

ref: Se trata de un estudio epidemiológico observacional realizado en el estado de Paraíba.
bt_tgt: This was an observational epidemiological study conducted in the state of Paraíba.

src: The method for analyzing rural/urban typologies was based on data mining, using the Apriori algorithm of association.

ref: El método de análisis de las tipologías rural/urbano se basó en la minería de datos, utilizando el algoritmo de asociación Apriori.
bt_tgt: The method for analyzing rural/urban typologies was based on data extraction, using the Apriori association algorithm.

src: Infant mortality was analyzed with descriptive statistics.
tgt: La mortalidad de los lactantes se analizó con estadística descriptiva.
ref: La mortalidad infantil se analizó con estadística descriptiva.
bt_tgt: Infant mortality was analyzed using descriptive statistics.

src: The data were obtained from the Mortality Information System of the Brazilian Ministry of Health, from 2007 to 2016, and municipal indicators were from IBGE.
tgt: Los datos se obtuvieron del Sistema de Información de Mortalidad del Ministerio de Salud brasileño, de 2007 a 2016, y los indicadores municipales fueron de IBGE.
ref: Los datos se obtuvieron del Sistema de Información de Mortalidad del Ministerio de Salud de Brasil, de 2007 a 2016, y los indicadores municipales fueron del IBGE.
bt_tgt: The data was obtained from the Brazilian Ministry of Health's Mortality Information System, 2007 to 2016, and the municipal indicators were IBGE.

src: The World Bank definition of rurality showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank classified 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%).
tgt: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios que se analizaron, el Banco Mundial clasificó 130 (65,66%) correctamente, y el IBGE 183 (82,06 %).
ref: La definición de ruralidad del Banco Mundial mostró kappa = 0,337, en comparación con la definición del IBGE, con kappa = 0,616. Entre los 223 municipios analizados, el Banco Mundial clasificó correctamente a 130 (65,66 %) y el IBGE, a 183 (82,06 %).
bt_tgt: The World Bank's definition of rural areas showed kappa = 0.337, compared to the IBGE definition, with kappa = 0.616. Among the 223 municipalities that were analyzed, the World Bank ranked 130 (65.66%) correctly, and the IBGE 183 (82.06%) correctly.

src: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities in Paraiba state was male gender (57.4%), brown skin color (61.1%), age from 0 to 7 days (52.4%), low birthweight (44%), and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2%).
tgt: El perfil epidemiológico predominante de mortalidad infantil en los municipios rurales del estado de Paraiba fue el sexo masculino (57,4 %), el color marrón de la piel (61,1 %), la edad de 0 a 7 días (52,4 %), el bajo peso al nacer (44 %) y la edad gestacional inferior a 37 semanas (43,2 %).
bt_tgt: The predominant epidemiological profile of infant mortality in the rural municipalities of Paraiba state was male (57.4 percent), brown skin (61.1 percent), age 0 to 7 days (52.4 percent), low birth weight (44 percent) and gestational age less than 37 weeks (43.2 percent).

src: Underlying cause of death was classified as avoidable death via interventions by the Brazilian Unified National Health System (65.2%).
tgt: La causa subyacente de muerte se clasificó como muerte evitable a través de intervenciones por parte del Sistema Nacional de Salud Unificado de Brasil (65,2%).

bt_tgt: The underlying cause of death was classified as preventable death through interventions by Brazil's National Unified Health System (65.2%).

src: This classification allowed studying the infant mortality profile in rural municipalities, which was similar to the overall profile, except for maternal schooling.
tgt: Esta clasificación permitió estudiar el perfil de mortalidad infantil en los municipios rurales, que fue similar al perfil general, excepto para la escolarización materna.
ref: Esta clasificación permitió estudiar el perfil de mortalidad infantil en los municipios rurales, que fue similar al perfil general, excepto por la escolaridad materna.
bt_tgt: This classification allowed the profile of infant mortality in rural municipalities to be studied, which was similar to the general profile, except for maternal schooling.

src: The urban/rural typology adopted by the IBGE was better than the World Bank at classifying the municipalities in Paraiba state.
tgt: La tipología urbana/rural adoptada por el IBGE fue mejor que la del Banco Mundial a la hora de clasificar los municipios del estado de Paraíba.
ref: La tipología urbana/rural adoptada por el IBGE fue mejor que la del Banco Mundial para clasificar los municipios del estado de Paraíba.
bt_tgt: The urban/rural typology adopted by the IBGE was better than that of the World Bank when it came to classifying the municipalities of the state of Paraíba.

src: Faced with the prospect of a collapsed health system due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the professionals involved in the Neonatal Screening Programme (NSP) of Catalonia had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient manner.
tgt: Ante la perspectiva de un sistema sanitario colapsado debido a la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de una forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.
ref: Ante la perspectiva de un sistema de salud colapsado por la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP, por sus siglas en inglés) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.

Ante la perspectiva de un sistema de salud colapsado por la pandemia de COVID-19, los profesionales implicados en el Programa de Cribado Neonatal (NSP, por sus siglas en inglés) de Cataluña tuvieron que adaptarse a esta situación de forma flexible, contundente y eficiente.
bt_tgt: Faced with the prospect of a healthcare system collapsing due to the COVID-19 pandemic, professionals involved in Catalonia's Neonatal Screening Program (NSP) had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient manner.

src: The most important goals were to prevent the risk of infection in the professionals, in families and their newborns, as well as to ensure the same effectiveness for the early detection of the diseases included in our programme.
tgt: Los objetivos más importantes eran prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como garantizar la misma efectividad para la detección temprana de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.
ref: Los objetivos más importantes eran prevenir el riesgo de infección en los profesionales, en las familias y en sus recién nacidos, así como garantizar la misma eficacia para la detección precoz de las enfermedades incluidas en nuestro programa.
bt_tgt: The most important goals were to prevent the risk of infection in professionals, families and their newborns, and to ensure the same effectiveness for early detection of diseases included in our program.

src: To this end, the laboratory was reorganised by dividing the staff into groups and the spaces were redistributed.
tgt: Con este fin, el laboratorio fue reorganizado dividiendo al personal en grupos y los espacios fueron redistribuidos.
ref: Para ello, se reorganizó el laboratorio dividiendo al personal en grupos y se redistribuyeron los espacios.
bt_tgt: To this end, the laboratory was reorganized by dividing the staff into groups and the spaces were redistributed.

src: It was also necessary to modify several protocols and circuits, especially for the management of early discharges from maternity centres, and for the collection of the necessary second samples (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low quality samples).
tgt: También fue necesario modificar varios protocolos y circuitos, especialmente para la gestión de altas tempranas de centros de maternidad, y para la recogida de las segundas muestras necesarias (de recién nacidos con resultados no concluyentes o para muestras de baja calidad).
ref: También fue necesario modificar varios protocolos y circuitos, especialmente para la gestión de las altas tempranas de las maternidades, y para la recogida de las segundas muestras necesarias (de recién nacidos con resultados no concluyentes o de baja calidad).
bt_tgt: It was also necessary to modify several protocols and circuits, especially for the management of early births in maternity centers, and for the collection of the second samples needed (from newborns with inconclusive results or for low-quality samples).

src: In general, a 36% reduction in the time of arrival of these second samples at the laboratory was achieved with respect to the previous circuit.
tgt: En general, se consiguió una reducción del 36% en el tiempo de llegada de estas segundas muestras al laboratorio con respecto al circuito anterior.
ref: En general, se logró una reducción del 36 % en el tiempo de llegada de estas segundas muestras al laboratorio con respecto al circuito anterior.
bt_tgt: In general, a 36% reduction in the time of arrival of these second samples in the laboratory was achieved compared to the previous circuit.

src: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100% reduction in the request for second samples and a 70% reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.
tgt: En el caso específico de la detección de fibrosis quística, la implementación de una nueva estrategia significó una reducción del 100 % en la solicitud de segundas muestras y una reducción del 70 % en la edad de diagnóstico del recién nacido.
bt_tgt: In the specific case of cystic fibrosis detection, the implementation of a new strategy meant a 100 percent reduction in the request for second samples and a 70 percent reduction in the age of diagnosis of the newborn.

src: Faced with the prospect of a collapsed health system due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the professionals involved in the Neonatal Screening Programme (NSP) of Catalonia had to adapt to this situation in a flexible, forceful and efficient manner.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media de 12 años; DE de 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad de 5 a 18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de su hijo (dependencia para el manejo de las necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto ocular al hablar), frecuencia de la participación y de la CdV. La relación lineal entre la capacidad de respuesta y la capacidad de respuesta fue de respuesta de los pacientes.
ref: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; DE de 3 años y 11 meses; intervalo de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett facilitaron información sobre la funcionalidad de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), la frecuencia de participación y la CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre la funcionalidad, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para gestionar sus necesidades personales y con contacto visual limitado al hablar presentaron una CdV peor. Una funcionalidad menos deteriorada se asoció a una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció a una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza al 95 %: 1,56-3,78).

src: After matching for socioeconomic and obstetric care characteristics, the highest odds of spontaneous prematurity were seen in younger adolescents compared to older adolescents (OR = 1.49; 95%CI: 1.07-2.06), and young adults (OR = 2.38; 95%CI: 1.82-3.12).

bt_tgt: After matching by socioeconomic characteristics and obstetric care, the higher probabilities of spontaneous prematurity were observed in younger adolescents compared to older adolescents (OR = 1.49; CI of 95 percent: 1.07-2.06) and young adults (OR = 2.38; CI of 95 percent: 1.82-3,12).

src: There were differential effects by age, such that older youth had less beneficial mental health outcomes and a smaller decrease in frequency of hash use.

src: The current study contributes to a sparse literature on moderators of Functional Family Therapy (FFT) by examining whether responsiveness to FFT, measured by a broad range of outcomes, varies by adolescent gender, age, and their interaction.
tgt: El estudio actual contribuye a una literatura escasa sobre moderadores de Terapia Familiar Funcional (FFT) al examinar si la capacidad de respuesta a FFT, medida por una amplia gama de resultados, varía según el sexo del adolescente, la edad y su interacción.

bt_tgt: The current study contributes to a limited literature on moderators of Functional Family Therapy (FFT) by examining whether the responsiveness to FFT, as measured by a wide range of outcomes, varies according to the sex of the adolescent, age and their interaction.

src: This finding adds to literature which has evidenced that family functioning is particularly important for girls by suggesting that FFT is important for improving older girls' mental health and family functioning in particular.
tgt: Este hallazgo se suma a la literatura que ha evidenciado que el funcionamiento familiar es particularmente importante para las niñas, sugiriendo que la FFT es importante para mejorar la salud mental de las niñas mayores y el funcionamiento familiar en particular.
bt_tgt: This finding is in addition to the literature that has shown that family functioning is particularly important for girls, suggesting that FFT is important for improving the mental health of older girls and family functioning in particular.

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; SD 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), frecuencia de participación y CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre el funcionamiento, la participación y la CdV del niño. Los niños con mayor dependencia para manejar sus necesidades personales y contacto visual limitado al hablar experimentaron una CdV más pobre. Un funcionamiento menos deteriorado se asoció con una participación más frecuente, lo que, a su vez, se asoció con una ganancia de 3 puntos en la calidad de vida por cada punto adicional en la frecuencia de participación (coeficiente = 2,67, intervalo de confianza del 95 %: 1,56-3,78).

src: The effect of impaired functioning on QoL was partially mediated by participation in children with greater dependency in managing personal needs and those with mildly impaired communication.

bt_tgt: The effect of the deterioration in functioning on the CdV was partly mediated by the involvement of children with greater dependence on the management of personal needs and who had a slight deterioration in communication.

src: Greater levels of impairments with poorer functioning, notably a high level of dependence, were associated with poorer QoL. Poorer QoL can be partly explained by less frequent community participation.

src: To investigate associations between functioning, community participation, and quality of life (QoL) and identify whether participation mediates the effects of functioning on QoL.

src: The data are from the Birth in Brazil study, a national survey consisting of 23,894 postpartum women and their newborn infants.
tgt: Los datos provienen del estudio Nacimiento en Brasil, una encuesta nacional que consta de 23.894 mujeres posparto y sus recién nacidos.
bt_tgt: The data comes from the Nacimiento en Brasil study, a national survey of 23,894 postpartum women and their newborns.

src: A matching method was established, based on propensity scores, to deal with differences between the groups due to the non-experimental design of the Birth in Brazil study.
tgt: Se estableció un método de igualación, basado en puntuaciones de propensión, para tratar las diferencias entre los grupos debido al diseño no experimental del estudio Birth in Brazil.
bt_tgt: A method of equalization, based on propensity scores, was established to address differences between groups due to the non-experimental design of the Birth in Brazil study.

src: The study revealed social, economic, and maternal care disparities between the women according to age bracket.
tgt: El estudio reveló disparidades sociales, económicas y de atención materna entre las mujeres según el tramo de edad.
bt_tgt: The study revealed social, economic and maternal care disparities among women according to age group.

src: The highest proportions of teenage mothers were in the least developed regions of Brazil (North and Northeast) and in the poorest economic classes.
tgt: Las mayores proporciones de madres adolescentes se dieron en las regiones menos desarrolladas de Brasil (Norte y Nordeste) y en las clases económicas más pobres.
ref: Las mayores proporciones de madres adolescentes se encontraban en las regiones menos desarrolladas de Brasil (Norte y Nordeste) y en las clases económicas más pobres.
Las mayores proporciones de madres adolescentes se encontraban en las regiones menos desarrolladas de Brasil (Norte y Nordeste) y en las clases económicas más pobres.
bt_tgt: The highest proportions of teenage mothers occurred in the least developed regions of Brazil (Northeast and Northeast) and in the poorest economic classes.

src: The study outcome was gestational age, considering all the premature births (gestational age < 37 weeks) and term births (gestational age 37 weeks to 41 weeks and 6 days).
tgt: El resultado del estudio fue la edad gestacional, considerando todos los partos prematuros (edad gestacional < 37 semanas) y nacidos a término (edad gestacional 37 semanas a 41 semanas y 6 días).
bt_tgt: The result of the study was the gestational age, considering all preterm births (gestational age <37 weeks) and term births (gestational age 37 weeks to 41 weeks and 6 days).

src: After matching for socioeconomic and obstetric care characteristics, the highest odds of spontaneous prematurity were seen in younger adolescents compared to older adolescents (OR = 1.49; 95%CI: 1.07-2.06), and young adults (OR = 2.38; 95%CI: 1.82-3.12).
tgt: Después de emparejar las características socioeconómicas y de atención obstétrica, las probabilidades más altas de prematuridad espontánea se observaron en adolescentes más jóvenes en comparación con adolescentes mayores (OR = 1,49; IC del 95 %: 1,07-2,06) y adultos jóvenes (OR = 2,38; IC del 95 %: 1.82-3.12).
ref: Después de emparejar las características socioeconómicas y de atención obstétrica, las probabilidades más altas de prematuridad espontánea se observaron en adolescentes más jóvenes en comparación con adolescentes mayores (OR = 1,49; IC del 95 %: 1,07-2,06) y adultos jóvenes (OR = 2,38; IC del 95 %: 1,82-3,12).
bt_tgt: After matching the socioeconomic characteristics and obstetric care, the highest probabilities of spontaneous prematurity were observed in younger adolescents compared to older adolescents (OR = 1.49; CI of 95 percent: 1.07-2.06) and young adults (OR = 2.38; CI of 95 percent: 1.82-3.12).

src: The study aims to evaluate the association between teenage pregnancy and prematurity.
tgt: El estudio tiene como objetivo evaluar la asociación entre el embarazo en la adolescencia y la prematuridad.
bt_tgt: The study aims to evaluate the association between teen pregnancy and prematurity.

src: The information was obtained from interviews with the mothers during their postpartum hospital stay.
tgt: La información se obtuvo de entrevistas con las madres durante su estancia hospitalaria posparto.
bt_tgt: The information was obtained from interviews with the mothers during their postpartum hospital stay.

src: There are a variety of instruments and indicators to assess continuity of care; however there is a lack of those that describe the result of coordination between the health care levels.
tgt: Hay una variedad de instrumentos e indicadores para evaluar la continuidad de la atención; sin embargo faltan aquellos que describen el resultado de la coordinación entre los niveles de atención en salud.
ref: Hay una variedad de instrumentos e indicadores para evaluar la continuidad de la atención; sin embargo faltan aquellos que describen el resultado de la coordinación entre los niveles de atención de salud.

Hay una variedad de instrumentos e indicadores para evaluar la continuidad de la atención; sin embargo faltan aquellos que describen el resultado de la coordinación entre los niveles de atención de salud.
bt_tgt: There are a variety of tools and indicators for assessing continuity of care; however, there are those that lack to describe the outcome of coordination between levels of health care.

src: Two indicators were analyzed: the outcome of the reference to general surgery, categorized as resolved, withdrawal and not resolved; and the time of solution of the surgical problem, which measures the median in calendar days from the issuance of the reference to the counter-reference for the reason of original sending.
tgt: Se analizaron dos indicadores: el resultado de la referencia a cirugía general, categorizado como resuelto, retiro y no resuelto; y el tiempo de solución del problema quirúrgico, que mide la mediana en días naturales desde la emisión de la referencia hasta la contrarreferencia por motivo de envío original.
bt_tgt: Two indicators were analyzed: the result of the reference to general surgery, categorized as solved, withdrawal and unresolved; and the time of resolution of the surgical problem, which measures the median in calendar days from the issuance of the reference to the counterreference for the original shipment.

src: The overall solution time of the surgical problem in the medical unit is within the range built with previous studies, but in specific diagnoses there are significant variations.
tgt: El tiempo total de solución del problema quirúrgico en la unidad médica está dentro del rango establecido con estudios previos, pero en los diagnósticos específicos existen variaciones significativas.
bt_tgt: The total time taken to solve the surgical problem in the medical unit is within the range established by previous studies, but there are significant variations in specific diagnoses.

src: The frequency of solution of the surgical problem was high for diagnoses of greater risk.
tgt: La frecuencia de solución del problema quirúrgico fue alta para diagnósticos de mayor riesgo.
bt_tgt: The frequency of surgical problem solving was high for diagnoses of higher risk.

src: To show two indicators that summarizes the result of the complete circuit primary level-secondary level-primary level.
tgt: Mostrar dos indicadores que resumen el resultado del circuito completo nivel primario-nivel secundario-nivel primario.
ref: Mostrar dos indicadores que resumen el resultado del circuito completo de nivel primario-nivel secundario-nivel primario.

src: An observational prospective cohort study was conducted, with a one-year follow-up of a random sample of the references to general surgery services in a family medicine unit of the IMSS.
tgt: Se realizó un estudio observacional prospectivo de cohortes, con un seguimiento de un año de una muestra aleatoria de las referencias a los servicios de cirugía general en una unidad de medicina familiar del IMSS.
bt_tgt: A prospective cohort observational study was conducted, followed for a year by a random sample of references to general surgery services in a family medicine unit of the IMSS.

src: The indicators were compared by characteristics of the patient and the first level physician.
tgt: Los indicadores se compararon según las características del paciente y del médico de primer nivel.
ref: Los indicadores fueron comparados por las características del paciente y del médico de primer nivel.
bt_tgt: The indicators were compared based on the characteristics of the patient and the primary care physician.

src: No statistically significant differences were found according the evaluated characteristics.
tgt: No se encontraron diferencias estadísticamente significativas de acuerdo con las características evaluadas.
bt_tgt: No statistically significant differences were found in the evaluated characteristics.

src: The article considers the COVID-19 pandemic impact on the population mental health, the main psychogenic and somatogenic mental disorders associated with COVID-19 are distinguished.
tgt: В статье рассмотрено влияние пандемии COVID-19 на психическое здоровье населения и выделены основные психогенные и соматогенные психические расстройства, ассоциируемые с COVID-19.
bt_tgt: The article examines the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the mental health of the population and highlights the main psychogenic and somatotogenic mental disorders associated with COVID-19.

src: The comorbid PTSD clinical features are described.
tgt: Описаны клинические особенности коморбидного ПТСР.
bt_tgt: Clinical features of comorbid PTSD have been described.

src: The mental health risk factors for health workers are presented.
tgt: Представлены факторы риска для психического здоровья медицинских работников.
bt_tgt: Risk factors for the mental health of medical workers are presented.

src: The psychotherapeutic and psychopharmaceutical approaches are proposed.
tgt: Предложены психотерапевтический и психофармакологический подходы.
bt_tgt: Psychotherapeutic and psychopharmacological approaches are proposed.

src: However, despite successful use of lithium in the treatment of affective disorders for almost 40 years, the mechanisms of its therapeutic action are still poorly understood.
tgt: Однако, несмотря на успешное применение лития в лечении аффективных расстройств в течение почти 40 лет, механизмы его терапевтического действия до сих пор плохо изучены.
bt_tgt: However, despite the successful use of lithium in the treatment of affective disorders for nearly 40 years, the mechanisms of its therapeutic action are still poorly studied.

src: This review presents and summarizes the current literature about the use of lithium in treatment of affective disorders, as well as its effects on cellular physiology, with a separate description of the effect of this ion on the functioning of nerve tissue and ion-molecular mechanisms.
tgt: В данном обзоре представлена и обобщена современная литература об использовании лития в лечении аффективных расстройств, а также о его влиянии на клеточную физиологию, с отдельным описанием влияния этого иона на функционирование нервной ткани и ионно-молекулярные механизмы.
bt_tgt: This review presents and summarizes the current literature on the use of lithium in the treatment of affective disorders, as well as its influence on cellular physiology, with a separate description of the influence of this ion on the functioning of nerve tissue and ion-molecular mechanisms.

src: Inducing of pathological autoimmune response contributes to the development of Miller Fischer and Guillain-Barré syndrome.
tgt: Индуцирование патологического аутоиммунного ответа способствует развитию синдрома Миллера — Фишера и Гийена — Барре.
bt_tgt: Inducing a pathological autoimmune response contributes to the development of Miller syndrome  Fisher and Gianna  Barre.

src: The number of COVID-19 patients is increasing worldwide and the number of patients with neurological manifestations of a new coronavirus infection is increasing as well.
tgt: Во всем мире растет число пациентов с COVID-19, а также увеличивается число пациентов с неврологическими проявлениями новой коронавирусной инфекции.
bt_tgt: Worldwide, the number of patients with COVID-19 is increasing, as is the number of patients with neurological manifestations of the new coronavirus infection.

src: Pathognomonic for COVID-19 is the presence of cephalgic syndrome, infectious-toxic encephalopathy, hypo- and anosmia and ageusia.
tgt: Патогномоничным для COVID-19 симптомом является наличие цефалгического синдрома, инфекционно-токсической энцефалопатии, гипосмии, аносмии и агевзии.
bt_tgt: A pathogenomic symptom for COVID-19 is the presence of cephalgic syndrome, infectious-toxic encephalopathy, hyposmia, anosmia and agevasia.

src: There is also a special form of COVID-19-associated stroke.
tgt: Существует также особая форма инсульта, ассоциированная с COVID-19.
bt_tgt: There is also a special form of stroke associated with COVID-19.

src: Almost all post-COVID-19 patients complain of severe fatigue, emotional lability, and sometimes have features of asthenic-neurotic, anxiety-phobic disorders and apato-abulic syndromes, which require rehabilitation measures, as well as courses of restorative neurotrophic and nootropic therapy.
tgt: Почти все пациенты, перенесшие COVID-19, жалуются на сильную усталость, эмоциональную лабильность, а иногда имеют признаки астено-невротических, тревожно-фобических расстройств и апато-абулического синдрома, требующих реабилитационных мероприятий, а также курсов восстановительной нейротрофической и ноотропной терапии.
bt_tgt: Almost all patients who have experienced COVID-19 complain of severe fatigue, emotional lability, and sometimes have signs of asthenic-neurotic, anxiety-phobic disorders and apatho-abulic syndrome, requiring rehabilitation measures, as well as courses of restorative neurotrophic and nootropic therapy.

src: The features of vertebral pain (VP) and quality of life in postmenopausal women were analyzed depending on the number and location of vertebral fractures (VF).
tgt: Проанализированы особенности вертебрального болевого синдрома (ВБС) и качества жизни у женщин в постменопаузе в зависимости от количества и локализации переломов позвонков (ПП).
bt_tgt: The features of the vertebral pain syndrome (VPS) and quality of life in postmenopausal women were analyzed depending on the number and localization of spinal fractures.

src: It was found that the intensity of pain in thoracic and lumbar spines, according to McGill pain index, was significantly higher in patients with two or more VF compared to women without any fractures, and absence of differences in subjects with a single VF.
tgt: Обнаружено, что интенсивность боли в грудном и поясничном отделах позвоночника, согласно опроснику Мак-Гилла по установлению интенсивности боли, была достоверно выше у пациенток с двумя и более ПП по сравнению с женщинами без переломов, а при единичном ПП различия у субъектов отсутствовали.
bt_tgt: It was found that the intensity of pain in the chest and lumbar spine, according to a McGill pain intensity questionnaire, was reliably higher in patients with two or more PP compared to women without fractures, and with single PP there was no difference in subjects.

src: Most indices of 11-component Numerical Rating Scale at the thoracic spine were significantly higher only in females with two or more VF.
tgt: Большинство показателей 11-компонентной числовой рейтинговой шкалы в грудном отделе позвоночника были значительно выше только у женщин с двумя и более ПП.
bt_tgt: Most of the scores on the 11-component numerical rating scale in the thoracic division of the spine were significantly higher only in women with two or more PPs.

src: In patients with thoracic spine fractures most parameters of VP measured at this level were significantly higher compared to control values, whereas in patients with lumbar spine fractures most indices did not differ from the corresponding parameters in subjects without fractures.
tgt: У пациенток с переломами грудного отдела позвоночника большинство параметров ВБC, измеренных на этом уровне, были достоверно выше контрольных значений, тогда как у пациенток с переломами поясничного отдела позвоночника большинство показателей не отличались от соответствующих параметров у субъектов без переломов.
bt_tgt: In patients with spinal fractures, most of the VBC parameters measured at this level were reliably above control values, while in patients with spinal fractures, most of the parameters did not differ from the corresponding parameters in subjects without fractures.

src: There were no established significant differences of quality of life indices according to the EuroQol-5D questionnaire in senior women depending on the number and location of VF, while disturbances of daily activity parameters according to the Roland-Morris questionnaire were found in patients with 2 or more VF.
tgt: Существенных различий в показателях качества жизни по опроснику EuroQol-5D у женщин старшего возраста в зависимости от количества и расположения ПП не выявлено, а у пациенток с 2 и более ПП выявлены нарушения параметров повседневной деятельности по опроснику Роланда — Морриса.
bt_tgt: Significant differences in the quality of life indicators of EuroQol-5D surveyed older women depending on the number and location of PPD were not detected, and patients with 2 or more PPDs were detected as having violations of the parameters of daily activity in the Roland Morris questionnaire.

src: Novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19, besides affecting the respiratory system, may lead to central and peripheral nervous system disorders and also cause muscular symptoms.
tgt: Новый коронавирус SARS-CoV-2 и COVID-19, помимо воздействия на дыхательную систему, могут приводить к нарушениям центральной и периферической нервной системы, а также вызывать мышечные симптомы.
bt_tgt: The new coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 and COVID-19, in addition to affecting the respiratory system, can cause disorders of the central and peripheral nervous systems, as well as cause muscle symptoms.

src: There is a correlation between the severity of COVID-19 and the severity and frequency of neurologic complications.
tgt: Существует корреляция между тяжестью COVID-19 и степенью и частотой неврологических осложнений.
bt_tgt: There is a correlation between the severity of COVID-19 and the degree and frequency of neurological complications.

src: Severe neurologic symptoms are primarily observed in patients with severe COVID-19.
tgt: Серьезные неврологические симптомы в первую очередь наблюдаются у пациентов с тяжелым течением COVID-19.
bt_tgt: Serious neurological symptoms are primarily observed in patients with severe COVID-19 infection.

src: Neurologic-associated symptoms may include stroke, acute necrotizing encephalopathy, and Guillen-Barre syndrome.
tgt: Неврологические симптомы могут включать инсульт, острую некротизирующую энцефалопатию и синдром Гийена — Барре.
bt_tgt: Neurological symptoms may include stroke, acute necrotizing encephalitis, and Guayna's syndrome.

src: Diseases that potentially aggravate COVID-19 and increase the risk of neurologic complications include arterial hypertension, diabetes, chronic diseases of the heart and respiratory system.
tgt: Заболевания, которые потенциально усугубляют течение COVID-19 и повышают риск неврологических осложнений, включают артериальную гипертензию, диабет, хронические заболевания сердца и дыхательной системы.
bt_tgt: Diseases that potentially aggravate the course of COVID-19 and increase the risk of neurological complications include hypertension, diabetes, chronic heart and respiratory disease.

src: The probable impact of human coronaviruses on chronic and progressive diseases of the nervous system with particular respect to multiple sclerosis is reviewed.
tgt: Рассмотрено вероятное влияние коронавирусов человека на хронические и прогрессирующие заболевания нервной системы, в частности на примере рассеянного склероза.
bt_tgt: The likely impact of human coronavirus on chronic and progressive diseases of the nervous system, particularly in the case of multiple sclerosis, has been considered.

src: A triage plan for stroke and MS patients during the COVID-19 pandemic, depending on the risk of coronavirus infection, is presented.
tgt: Представлен план сортировки пациентов, перенесших инсульт, и пациентов с РС во время пандемии COVID-19 в зависимости от риска заражения коронавирусом.
bt_tgt: A plan was presented to sort patients who had suffered a stroke and patients with RA during the COVID-19 pandemic according to the risk of coronavirus infection.

src: New prospects associated with the use of laser radiation of different wavelengths in the ultraviolet (365 nm) and the green emission spectrum (525 nm) have appeared in recent years.
tgt: В последние годы появились новые перспективы, связанные с использованием лазерного излучения разных длин волн в ультрафиолетовом диапазоне (365 нм) и зеленом спектре излучения (525 нм).

errors_tgt.term: ультрафиолетовом диапазоне (365 нм) и зеленом спектре

bt_tgt: In recent years, new prospects have emerged, involving the use of laser radiation of different wavelengths in the ultraviolet range (365 nm) and green spectrum radiation (525 nm).

src: The high prevalence of the trophic leg ulcers necessitates the search for more effective methods of conservative treatment.
tgt: Высокая распространенность трофических язв нижних конечностей обуславливает необходимость поиска более эффективных методов консервативного лечения.
bt_tgt: The high prevalence of trophic lower limb ulcers makes it necessary to seek more effective conservative treatments.

src: Development and scientific justification for the low-intensity laser radiation of different wavelengths combined use in patients with trophic leg ulcers and chronic venous insufficiency (CVI). 102 patients with trophic leg ulcers and CVI were examined.
tgt: Разработка и научное обоснование комбинированного применения низкоинтенсивного лазерного излучения разных длин волн у пациентов с трофическими язвами нижних конечностей на фоне хронической венозной недостаточности (ХВН). Обследованы 102 пациента с трофическими язвами нижних конечностей на фоне ХВН.
bt_tgt: The development and scientific justification of the combined use of low-intensity laser radiation of different wavelengths in patients with trophic ulcers of the lower extremities against the background of chronic venous insufficiency (CHF) was studied in 102 patients with trophic ulcers of the lower extremities against the background of CHF.

src: They were divided into 3 equal groups using simple randomization.
tgt: Они были разделены на 3 равные группы методом простой рандомизации.
bt_tgt: They were divided into 3 equal groups by simple randomization.

src: Patients in the control group received only traditional conservative therapy; comparison group - traditional conservative therapy and an intravenous laser blood irradiation (ILBI) (λ - 635 nm); the main group - traditional conservative therapy and different wavelengths laser therapy (LT) course.
tgt: В контрольной группе пациенты получали только традиционную консервативную терапию, в группе сравнения — традиционную консервативную терапию и курс процедур внутривенного лазерного облучения крови (ВЛОК) (λ — 635 нм); в основной группе — традиционную консервативную терапию и курс процедур лазеротерапии (ЛТ) разных длин волн.
bt_tgt: In the control group, patients received only traditional conservative therapy, in the comparison group  traditional conservative therapy and the course of intravenous laser blood radiation procedures (IVR) (λ  635 nm); in the main group  traditional conservative therapy and the course of laser therapy (LT) of different wavelengths.

src: A more significant improvement in the clinical condition occurred under the influence of the course application of combined different wavelengths laser therapy in patients with trophic venous leg ulcers.
tgt: Более значительное улучшение клинического состояния произошло под воздействием курсового применения комбинированной лазеротерапии разной длины волны у больных с трофическими венозными язвами нижних конечностей.
bt_tgt: A more significant improvement in clinical status occurred under the influence of the course application of combination laser therapy of different wavelengths in patients with trophic venous ulcers of the lower extremities.

src: Compared to patients who received traditional conservative therapy and in combination with ILBI 635 nm, the speed of reparative regeneration of trophic ulcers increased, the time for cleansing trophic ulcers from devitalized tissues was reduced.
tgt: По сравнению с пациентами, получавшими традиционную консервативную терапию и в комплексе с ВЛОК 635 нм, увеличивалась скорость репаративной регенерации трофических язв, сокращалось время очищения трофических язв от девитализированных тканей.
bt_tgt: Compared with patients receiving traditional conservative therapy and in combination with VLOK 635 nm, the rate of regenerative healing of trophic sores increased, the time taken to cleanse trophic sores from devitalised tissue was reduced.

src: Computer capillaroscopy data showed that the positive effect of laser exposure on all parts of the microcirculation underlies its therapeutic efficacy.
tgt: Данные компьютерной капилляроскопии показали, что в основе терапевтической эффективности лазерного воздействия лежит его положительное влияние на все звенья микроциркуляции.
bt_tgt: Computer capillary data showed that the therapeutic effectiveness of laser exposure is based on its positive effect on all microcirculation nodes.

src: The WHO Classification of Digestive System Tumors (WHO, 5th Edition, 2019) presents new provisions on the morphological, molecular genetic, and therapeutic aspects of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
tgt: В Классификации ВОЗ опухолей пищеварительной системы (ВОЗ, 5-е издание, 2019 г.) представлены новые положения о морфологических, молекулярно-генетических и терапевтических аспектах гепатоцеллюлярной карциномы (ГЦК).
bt_tgt: The WHO Classification of Digestive System Tumors (WHO, 5th edition, 2019) presents new provisions on the morphological, molecular-genetic and therapeutic aspects of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

src: This classification versus the 2010 edition underwent substantial changes.
tgt: В классификации произошли значительные изменения по сравнению с редакцией 2010 г.
bt_tgt: There have been significant changes in the classification compared to the 2010 edition.

src: Undifferentiated carcinoma (ICD-0: 8020/3) was excluded.
tgt: Недифференцированная карцинома (МКБ-0: 8020/3) была исключена.
bt_tgt: The undifferentiated carcinoma (MBC-0: 8020/3) was excluded.

src: The TNM staging system introduces additional gradations.
tgt: В системе стадирования TNM введены дополнительные градации.
bt_tgt: Additional gradations have been introduced in the TNM staging system.

src: Based on new evidence, HCC types and subtypes (scirrhous, clear cell, steatohepatic, and others) were identified depending on gene mutations according to ICD-11.
tgt: На основе новых данных типы и подтипы ГЦК (скиррозный, светлоклеточный, стеатогепатитный и другие) были идентифицированы в зависимости от генных мутаций в соответствии с МКБ-11.
bt_tgt: Based on new data, the types and subtypes of GCC (skinary, light-cell, steatohepatitis, and others) were identified according to gene mutations in accordance with the IBC-11.

src: The classification changes are of not only important theoretical, but also applied significance.
tgt: Изменения в классификации имеют не только важное теоретическое, но и прикладное значение.
bt_tgt: Changes in classification have not only important theoretical but also applied significance.

src: These are valuable for oncologists and pathologists.
tgt: Они важны для онкологов и патологоанатомов.
bt_tgt: They are important for oncologists and pathologists.

src: To evaluate the effectiveness of use of low-frequency «thresholdless» transcranial magnetic stimulation in the treatment of patients in acute period of ischemic stroke.
tgt: Оценить эффективность применения низкочастотной «беспороговой» транскраниальной магнитной стимуляции в лечении пациентов в остром периоде ишемического инсульта.
bt_tgt: To evaluate the effectiveness of the use of low frequency transcranial magnetic stimulation in treating patients in the acute period of ischemic stroke.

src: As you know, complete successful recovery in stroke patients occurs only in 8% of cases, 20% need constant care.
tgt: Как известно, полное успешное выздоровление у пациентов с инсультом происходит только в 8% случаев, 20% нуждаются в постоянном уходе.
bt_tgt: As is well known, complete recovery in stroke patients occurs only in 8% of cases, 20% need constant care.

src: The use of innovative rehabilitation technologies, namely «thresholdless» low-frequency transcranial magnetic stimulation, will speed up the process of restoring impaired functions, increase independence in everyday life and, accordingly, the quality of life.
tgt: Применение инновационных реабилитационных технологий, а именно «беспороговой» низкочастотной транскраниальной магнитной стимуляции, ускорит процесс восстановления нарушенных функций, повысит самостоятельность в повседневной жизни и, соответственно, качество жизни.
bt_tgt: The use of innovative rehabilitation technologies, namely free-flow low-frequency transcranial magnetic stimulation, will speed up the process of restoring impaired functions, increase independence in daily life and, accordingly, quality of life.

src: The study included 93 patients aged from 49 to 68 years on second-third days of ischemic stroke.
tgt: В исследование были включены 93 пациента в возрасте от 49 до 68 лет на второй-третий день ишемического инсульта.
bt_tgt: The study included 93 patients aged 49 to 68 on the second-to-third day of an ischemic stroke.

src: The 1st (main) group
tgt: 1-я (основная) группа
bt_tgt: The 1st (main) group

src: This article deals with the bibliographic information relating to the Saratov period of life of Alexander Nikolayevich Bakulev, his scientific and practical activity at the Department of Hospital Surgery of the Saratov Medical University under the leadership of the Department's founder, Sergey Ivanovich Spasokukotsky having exerted the key influence on the formation of A.N. Bakulev as a surgeon and scientist.
tgt: В статье представлены библиографические сведения о саратовском периоде жизни Александра Николаевича Бакулева, его научно-практической деятельности на кафедре госпитальной хирургии Саратовского медицинского университета под руководством основателя кафедры Сергея Ивановича Спасокукоцкого, оказавшего ключевое влияние на становление А. Н. Бакулева как хирурга и ученого.
bt_tgt: The article presents bibliographical information about the Saratov period of Alexander Nikolayevich Bakulev's life, his scientific and practical activities at the Department of Hospital Surgery of the Saratov Medical University under the leadership of the department founder Sergey Ivanovich Spasoukoutsky, who had a key influence on the development of A.N. Bakulev as a surgeon and scientist.

src: The measurement of the film thickness of the composite cement Variolink Esthetic («Ivoclar-Vivadent», Liechtenstein) and the microhybrid composite Enamel («Micerium», Italy) was carried out according to ISO 4049: 2009 standards with a load force of 5 kg.
tgt: Измерение толщины пленки композитного цемента Variolink Esthetic («Ivoclar-Vivadent», Лихтенштейн) и микрогибридного композитного материала Enamel («Micerium», Италия) проводилось по стандартам ISO 4049:2009 с силой нагрузки в 5 кг.
bt_tgt: The thickness of the film of composite cement Variolink Esthetic (Ivoclar-Vivadent, Liechtenstein) and microhybrid composite material Enamel (Micerium, Italy) was measured according to ISO 4049:2009 with a load strength of 5 kg.

src: After preheating, the film thickness was changed from 23 microns (at 15 kg) to 44 microns (at 5 kg).
tgt: После предварительного нагревания толщина пленки изменилась с 23 мкм (при 15 кг) до 44 мкм (при 5 кг).
bt_tgt: After the preheating, the film thickness changed from 23 μm (at 15 kg) to 44 μm (at 5 kg).

src: One of the promising geroprotectors restoring the pineal melatonin synthesis is the AEDG (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) peptide.
tgt: Одним из перспективных геропротекторов, восстанавливающих синтез мелатонина шишковидной железой, является пептид AEDG (Ала-Глу-Асп-Гли).
bt_tgt: One of the promising heroprotectors that restore the synthesis of melatonin by the thyroid gland is the peptide AEDG (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly).

src: AEDG peptide increases in 1,7 times the 6-sulfatoxymelatonin (6-SOMT) excretion in the urine of middle-aged people.
tgt: Пептид AEDG увеличивает в 1,7 раза экскрецию 6-сульфатоксимелатонина (6-СОМТ) с мочой у людей среднего возраста.
