src: Rhabdomyolysis: early management
tgt: Rhabdomyolyse : prise en charge précoce
bt_tgt: Rhabdomyolyse: early onset of care.

src: Rhabdomyolysis is defined by myalgia, potentially painful myoedema and muscular weakness due to death of muscular fiber in the striated muscle.
tgt: La rhabdomyolyse est définie par une myalgie, un myxœdème potentiellement douloureux et une faiblesse musculaire due à la dégradation de la fibre musculaire dans le muscle strié.
bt_tgt: Rhabdomyolyse is defined by myalgia, a potentially painful myxodema and muscle weakness due to the breakdown of muscle fiber in striated muscle.

src: Frequent etiologies include physical effort, intoxication (alcohol, drugs and medication) and physical trauma.
tgt: Les étiologies fréquentes comprennent l’effort physique, l’intoxication (alcool, drogues et médicaments) et les traumatismes physiques.
bt_tgt: Common etiologies include physical exertion, intoxication (alcohol, drugs and drugs) and physical trauma.

src: Diagnosis relies on creatine kinase (CK) levels.
tgt: Le diagnostic repose sur les niveaux de créatine kinase (CK).
bt_tgt: The diagnosis is based on the levels of creatine kinase (CK).

src: The clinical spectrum of rhabdomyolysis includes an asymptomatic increased amount of CK as well as severe, life threatening complications such as acute renal failure and electrolyte disorders.
tgt: Le spectre clinique de la rhabdomyolyse comprend une augmentation asymptomatique du taux de CK ainsi que des complications graves, mettant en jeu le pronostic vital, telles que l'insuffisance rénale aiguë et les troubles électrolytiques.
bt_tgt: The clinical spectrum of rhabdomyolysis includes an asymptomatic increase in the rate of CK as well as serious complications, which play a vital role in prognosis, such as acute renal failure and electrolyte disorders.

src: Treatment is based on prevention and addressing complications.
tgt: Le traitement est basé sur la prévention et le traitement des complications.
bt_tgt: Treatment is based on the prevention and treatment of complications.

src: The aim of our retrospective study is to analyse the results of endoscopic macro-clips used for closing intestinal breaches in the real life.
tgt: L'objectif de notre étude rétrospective est d'analyser les résultats des macro clips endoscopiques utilisés pour refermer les brèches intestinales dans la vie réelle.
bt_tgt: The purpose of our retrospective study is to analyze the results of the endoscopic macro clips used to refer to intestinal fractures in real life.

src: Post-endoscopic, spontaneous perforations and surgical fistulas are included.
tgt: Les perforations post-endoscopiques spontanées et les fistules chirurgicales sont incluses.
bt_tgt: Spontaneous post-endoscopic perforations and surgical fistulas are included.

src: Efficacy of macro-clips for perforations and fistulas following endoscopic or surgical procedures. Retrospective analysis of 25 consecutive cases
tgt: Efficacité des macro-clips pour les perforations et les fistules à la suite d'interventions endoscopiques ou chirurgicales. Analyse rétrospective de 25 cas consécutifs
bt_tgt: The effectiveness of macro-clips for perforations and fistulas following endoscopic or surgical procedures.

src: Our results are compared with principal published series.
tgt: Nos résultats sont comparés aux principales séries publiées.
bt_tgt: Our results are compared to the main series published.

src: Between 2010 and 2015, 25 consecutive patients underwent an endoscopic suture with macro-clips to seal a breach resulting from endoscopic perforation, surgical fistula, invasive medical procedure or spontaneous perforation.
tgt: Entre 2010 et 2015, 25 patients consécutifs ont subi une suture endoscopique avec des macro-clips afin de sceller une brèche résultant d'une perforation endoscopique, d'une fistule chirurgicale, d'un acte médical invasif ou d'une perforation spontanée.
bt_tgt: Between 2010 and 2015, 25 consecutive patients underwent an endoscopic suture with macro-clips to seal a break resulting from an endoscopic perforation, surgical fistula, invasive medical act or spontaneous perforation.

src: The endoscopic efficacy was immediate for all patients whose perforation was of endoscopic aetiology.
tgt: L'efficacité endoscopique a été immédiate pour tous les patients dont la perforation était d'étiologie endoscopique.
bt_tgt: Endoscopic efficacy was immediately demonstrated for all patients whose perforation was endoscopic.

src: None of them required surgery.
tgt: Aucun d'entre eux n'a nécessité d'intervention chirurgicale.
bt_tgt: None of them require surgery.

src: Secondary complementary endoscopic treatment was only used in 6/25 patients.
tgt: Le traitement endoscopique complémentaire secondaire n'a été utilisé que chez 6 patients sur 25.
bt_tgt: Secondary complementary endoscopic treatment has only been used in 6 out of 25 patients.

src: All of them had non-endoscopic aetiology for their perforation.
tgt: Tous avaient une étiologie non endoscopique pour leur perforation.
bt_tgt: All had a non-endoscopic etiology for their perforation.

src: The survival at 1 month was 84 % and at 3 months of 76 %.
tgt: La survie à 1 mois était de 84 % et à 3 mois de 76 %.
bt_tgt: 1-month survival was 84% and 3-month survival was 76%.

src: Our results confirm the high efficiency of macro-clips in the treatment of endoscopic breaches in a regional hospital center.
tgt: Nos résultats confirment la grande efficacité des macro clips dans le traitement des brèches endoscopiques dans un centre hospitalier régional.
bt_tgt: Our results confirm the high effectiveness of macro clips in the treatment of endoscopic fractures in a regional hospital center.

src: The use of macro-clips seems less convincing for the closure of some postoperative fistula.
tgt: L'utilisation de macro-clips semble moins convaincante pour la fermeture de certaines fistules postopératoires.
bt_tgt: The use of macro-clips seems less convincing for the closure of certain postoperative fistulas.

src: The suture with macro-clips associated with endoscopic and medical treatments allowed to avoid surgical redo in some cases.
tgt: La suture avec des macro-clips associée à des traitements endoscopiques et médicaux a permis d'éviter une reprise chirurgicale dans certains cas.
bt_tgt: The sewing with macro-clips associated with endoscopic and medical treatments has allowed to avoid a surgical recovery in some cases.

src: There are two types of ID : 1) absolute ID (AID), in case of decrease in iron reserves and circulating iron, or 2) functional ID (FID), in case of decrease in circulating iron, while reserves are preserved or increased.
tgt: Il existe deux types de CF : 1) la CF absolue (CFA), en cas de diminution des réserves de fer et du fer circulant, ou 2) la CF fonctionnelle (CFF), en cas de diminution des réserves de fer circulant, alors que les réserves sont préservées ou augmentées.

errors_tgt.term: alors que les réserves sont préservées ou augmentées.

bt_tgt: There are two types of CF: 1) absolute CF (CFA), when iron and circulating iron reserves are reduced, or 2) functional CF (CFF), when circulating iron reserves are reduced, while reserves are preserved or increased.

src: FID is characterized by elevated serum ferritin, normal or low TS, and normal sTfR levels.
tgt: La CFF est caractérisée par une ferritine sérique élevée, une Tf normale ou basse et des taux de sTfR normaux.
bt_tgt: CFF is characterized by high serum ferritin, normal or low Tf, and normal sTfR levels.

src: AID is characterized by low serum ferritin and transferrin saturation (TS).
tgt: La CFA se caractérise par une faible saturation sérique en ferritine et en transferrine (Tf).

errors_tgt.term: faible saturation sérique en ferritine et en transferrine (Tf)

bt_tgt: CFA is characterized by low serum ferritin and transferrin (Tf) saturation.

tgt: Carence en fer chez l'adulte : comprendre quelle évaluation biologique doit être réalisée

src: Iron is a major mineral in the human body.
tgt: Le fer est un minéral majeur dans le corps humain.

src: It participates in various metabolisms, including oxygen transport in hemoglobin.
tgt: Il participe à divers métabolismes, dont le transport de l’oxygène dans l’hémoglobine.
bt_tgt: It is involved in various metabolic processes, including the transport of oxygen in hemoglobin.

src: Iron deficiency (ID) is characterized by a deficit in circulating iron.
tgt: La carence en fer (CF) se caractérise par un déficit en fer circulant.
bt_tgt: La carence en fer (CF) is characterized by a circulating iron deficiency.

src: AID is mainly due to bleeding, usually gastrointestinal, while FID is linked to the inflammatory syndrome.
tgt: La CFA est principalement due à des saignements, généralement gastro-intestinaux, tandis que la CFF est liée au syndrome inflammatoire.
bt_tgt: CFA is mainly caused by bleeding, usually gastrointestinal, while CFF is linked to inflammatory syndrome.

src: Hypochromic microcytic anemia is frequent.
tgt: L'anémie microcytaire hypochrome est fréquente.
bt_tgt: Hypochrome microcyte anemia is common.

src: Furthermore, C-reactive protein levels are high, and there is non-regenerative non-macrocytic anemia.
tgt: De plus, les niveaux de protéine C-réactive sont élevés et il existe une anémie non régénérative non macrocytaire.
bt_tgt: In addition, levels of C-reactive protein are high and there is non-macrocyte non-regenerative anemia.

src: New biological tests (serum hepcidin) may be useful in case of doubt.
tgt: De nouveaux tests biologiques (hepcidine sérique) peuvent être utiles en cas de doute.
bt_tgt: New biological tests (serum hepcidine) can be useful in case of doubt.

src: This useful vision should enable them to regain autonomy in society for navigation, face recognition or reading.

bt_tgt: This useful vision should allow them to regain their autonomy in society for navigation, facial recognition or reading.

src: Various prostheses, in particular cortical prostheses, are currently in clinical trials for optic neuropathies (glaucoma).
tgt: Diverses prothèses, notamment corticales, font actuellement l'objet d'essais cliniques pour des neuropathies optiques (glaucome).
bt_tgt: Various prosthetics, including cortical ones, are currently undergoing clinical trials for optic neuropathies (glaucoma).

src: Other innovating strategies have obtained proofs of concepts in rodents but require a further validation in large animals prior to their evaluation on patients.
tgt: D'autres stratégies innovantes ont été démontrées sur les rongeurs, mais nécessitent une validation supplémentaire chez les grands animaux avant leur évaluation sur les patients.
bt_tgt: Other innovative strategies have been demonstrated on rodents, but require further validation in large animals before being evaluated on patients.

src: Visual prostheses aim at restoring useful vision to patients who have become blind.
tgt: Les prothèses visuelles visent à restaurer la vision utile des patients devenus aveugles.
bt_tgt: Visual prostheses are intended to restore the useful vision of patients who have become blind.

src: Optogenetic therapy, an alternative strategy, has now reached the stage of clinical trials at the retinal level while moving forward at the cortical level.
tgt: Une stratégie alternative, la thérapie optogénétique, est désormais en phase d'essais cliniques au niveau de la rétine, puis au niveau cortical.
bt_tgt: An alternative strategy, optogenetic therapy, is now in clinical trials at the retinal level and then at the cortical level.

src: Vision restoration: science fiction or reality?
tgt: Restauration de la vision : science-fiction ou réalité ?
bt_tgt: Restoration of vision: science fiction or reality ?

src: Two retinal prostheses have already obtained market authorization for patients affected by retinal dystrophies while a new device is in clinical trials for patients affected by age-related macular degeneration.
tgt: Deux prothèses rétiniennes ont déjà obtenu une autorisation de mise sur le marché pour les patients atteints de dystrophies rétiniennes, tandis qu'un nouveau dispositif fait l'objet d'essais cliniques pour les patients atteints de dégénérescence maculaire liée à l'âge.
bt_tgt: Two retinal prostheses have already received marketing authorization for patients with retinal dystrophies, while a new device is undergoing clinical trials for patients with age-related macular degeneration.

src: Restoring vision should therefore become a reality for many patients even if this vision will not be as extensive and perfect as natural vision.
tgt: La restauration de la vision devrait donc devenir une réalité pour de nombreux patients même si cette vision ne sera pas aussi étendue et parfaite que la vision naturelle.
bt_tgt: The restoration of vision should therefore become a reality for many patients even if this vision will not be as extensive and perfect as natural vision.

src: A model to predict SARS-CoV-2 infection based on the first three-month surveillance data in Brazil
tgt: Un modèle pour prédire l'infection par le SRAS-CoV-2 selon les données de surveillance des trois premiers mois au Brésil
bt_tgt: A model to predict the infection with SARS-CoV-2 based on surveillance data from the first three months in Brazil

src: COVID-19 diagnosis is a critical problem, mainly due to the lack or delay in the test results.
tgt: Le diagnostic de la COVID-19 est un problème critique, principalement en raison de l'absence ou du retard des résultats des tests.
bt_tgt: Diagnosing COVID-19 is a critical problem, mainly due to the absence or delay in test results.

src: We analysed suspected patients reported to the National Surveillance System that corresponded to the following case definition: patients with respiratory symptoms and fever, who travelled to regions with local or community transmission or who had close contact with a suspected or confirmed case.
tgt: Nous avons analysé les patients suspects signalés au Système national de surveillance qui correspondaient à la définition de cas suivante : patients présentant des symptômes respiratoires et de la fièvre, ayant voyagé dans des régions de transmission locale ou communautaire ou ayant été en contact étroit avec un cas suspect ou confirmé.
bt_tgt: We analyzed the suspected patients reported to the National Surveillance System that corresponded to the definition of the following cases: patients with respiratory symptoms and fever, who had traveled to local or community transmission areas, or who had been in close contact with a suspected or confirmed case.

src: Based on variables routinely collected, we obtained a multiple model using logistic regression.
tgt: Sur la base de variables recueillies régulièrement, nous avons obtenu un modèle multiple en utilisant la régression logistique.
bt_tgt: Based on regularly collected variables, we obtained a multiple model using logistic regression.

src: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and accuracy indicators were used for validation.
tgt: L'aire sous la courbe caractéristique de fonctionnement du récepteur (ASC) et les indicateurs de précision ont été utilisés pour la validation.
bt_tgt: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ASC) and precision indicators were used for validation.

src: With a data subset including 80% of patients from Sao Paulo (SP) and Rio Janeiro (RJ), we obtained a function which reached an AUC of 95.54% (95% CI: 94.41-96.67%) for the diagnosis of COVID-19 and accuracy of 90.1% (sensitivity 87.62% and specificity 92.02%).
tgt: Avec un sous-ensemble de données incluant 80 % de patients de Sao Paulo (SP) et de Rio Janeiro (RJ), nous avons obtenu une fonction qui a atteint une ASC de 95,54 % (IC à 95 % : 94,41 à 96,67 %) pour le diagnostic de la COVID-19 et une précision de 90,1 % (sensibilité 87,62 % et spécificité 92,02 %).
bt_tgt: With a subset of data including 80 percent of patients from Sao Paulo (SP) and Rio Janeiro (RJ), we obtained a function that achieved an ASC of 95.54 percent (IC at 95 percent: 94.41 to 96.67 percent) for the diagnosis of COVID-19 and an accuracy of 90.1 percent (sensitivity 87.62 percent and specificity 92.02 percent).

src: In a validation dataset including the other 20% of patients from SP and RJ, this model exhibited an AUC of 95.01% (92.51-97.5%) and accuracy of 89.47% (sensitivity 87.32% and specificity 91.36%).
tgt: Dans un ensemble de données de validation incluant les 20 % restants de patients de SP et RJ, ce modèle présentait une ASC de 95,01 % (92,51-97,5 %) et une précision de 89,47 % (sensibilité 87,32 % et spécificité 91,36 %).
bt_tgt: In a validation dataset including the remaining 20% of patients with SP and RJ, this model had an ASC of 95.01% (92.51-97.5%) and an accuracy of 89.47% (87.32% sensitivity and 91.36% specificity).

src: We obtained a model suitable for the clinical diagnosis of COVID-19 based on routinely collected surveillance data.
tgt: Nous avons obtenu un modèle adapté au diagnostic clinique de la COVID-19 basé sur des données de surveillance recueillies automatiquement.
bt_tgt: We have obtained a model adapted to the clinical diagnosis of COVID-19 based on automatically collected surveillance data.

src: Applications of this tool include early identification for specific treatment and isolation, rational use of laboratory tests, and input for modelling epidemiological trends.
tgt: Les applications de cet outil comprennent l'identification précoce pour un traitement et un isolement spécifiques, l'utilisation rationnelle des tests de laboratoire et la prémisse dans la modélisation des tendances épidémiologiques.
bt_tgt: The applications of this tool include early identification for specific treatment and isolation, the rational use of laboratory testing, and the premise in modeling epidemiological trends.

src: We aimed to obtain a model to predict SARS-CoV-2 infection in suspected patients reported to the Brazilian surveillance system.
tgt: Nous avons cherché à obtenir un modèle pour prédire l'infection par le SRAS-CoV-2 chez les patients suspects signalés au système de surveillance brésilien.
bt_tgt: We sought to obtain a model to predict the infection with SARS-CoV-2 in suspected patients reported to the Brazilian surveillance system.

src: We described 1468 COVID-19 cases (confirmed by RT-PCR) and 4271 patients with other illnesses.
tgt: Nous avons décrit 1 468 cas de COVID-19 (confirmés par RT-PCR) et 4 271 patients atteints d'autres maladies.
bt_tgt: We have described 1,468 cases of COVID-19 (confirmed by RT-PCR) and 4,271 patients with other diseases.

bt_tgt: Although it results in postoperative instability, secondary reconstruction is not always necessary.

src: Degenerative lesions of the anterior cruciate ligament: a frequent but poorly understood phenomenon
tgt: Lésions dégénératives du ligament croisé antérieur : un phénomène fréquent, mais mal compris
bt_tgt: Degenerative lesions of the anterior cruciate ligament: a common but misunderstood phenomenon.

src: Making more use of MRI, degenerative lesions of the anterior cruciate ligament are more frequently diagnosed.
tgt: L'utilisation poussée de l'IRM permet de diagnostiquer plus fréquemment les lésions dégénératives du ligament croisé antérieur.
bt_tgt: The extensive use of MRI allows for more frequent diagnosis of degenerative lesions of the anterior cruciate ligament.

src: Three separates entities are reported (mucoid degeneration, ganglion cyst and mucoid degeneration with ganglion cysts) but it is probably a continuum of the same degenerative process.
tgt: Trois entités distinctes sont rapportées (dégénérescence mucoïde, kyste ganglionnaire et dégénérescence mucoïde avec kystes ganglionnaires), mais il s'agit probablement d'un continuum du même processus dégénératif.
bt_tgt: Three distinct entities are related (mucoid degeneration, ganglionnaire cyst and mucoid degeneration with ganglionnaire cysts), but it is likely a continuum of the same degenerative process.

src: In middle aged individuals, it would result of repeated microtrauma in the setting of a narrow intercondylar notch and/or increased posterior tibial slope.

bt_tgt: In middle-aged people, this results in repeated microtrauma associated with narrow intercondylenic encrustation and/or an enlargement of the posterior tibial incision.

src: As a practice example, the division of pediatric oncology from the Children's Hospital St. Gallen describes their use and experience of two different methods of integrative medicine on a daily basis.
tgt: À titre d'exemple pratique, la division d'oncologie pédiatrique de l'Hôpital des Enfants de St Gall décrit leur utilisation et leur expérience de deux méthodes différentes de médecine intégrative au quotidien.

src: Integrative medicine in pediatric oncology

bt_tgt: New developments in interstitial pneumopathy associated with systemic sclerosis

src: Interstitial lung disease is a frequent complication of systemic sclerosis and has now become the leading cause of death in this disorder.
tgt: La maladie pulmonaire interstitielle est une complication fréquente de la sclérose systémique et est devenue la principale cause de décès dans cette maladie.
bt_tgt: Interstitial lung disease is a common complication of systemic sclerosis and has become the leading cause of death in this disease.

src: It mainly occurs during the first five years after the diagnosis of systemic sclerosis.

src: The most common radio-pathological presentation is nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, followed by usual interstitial pneumonia.

bt_tgt: The most common radiopathological presentation is nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, followed by usual interstitial pneumonia.

src: The classical immunosuppressive treatment of systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease is evolving, as recent studies suggest a beneficial effect of biological agents such as rituximab and tocilizumab, and antifibrotic drugs such as nintedanib.
tgt: Le traitement immunosuppresseur classique de la maladie pulmonaire interstitielle associée à la sclérose systémique évolue, car des études récentes suggèrent un effet bénéfique d’agents biologiques tels que le rituximab et le tocilizumab, et de médicaments antifibrotiques tels que le nintédanib.
bt_tgt: The classical immunosuppressive treatment of interstitial pulmonary disease associated with systemic sclerosis is evolving, as recent studies suggest a beneficial effect of biological agents such as rituximab and tocilizumab, and of antifibrotic drugs such as nintedanib.

src: Various risk factors are associated with the occurrence of interstitial lung disease, including the presence of anti-topoisomerase I antibodies (Scl-70) and the diffuse cutaneous form of systemic sclerosis.
tgt: Divers facteurs de risque sont associés à la survenue d'une pneumopathie interstitielle, notamment la présence d'anticorps anti-topoisomérase I (Scl-70) et la forme cutanée diffuse de la sclérodermie systémique.
bt_tgt: Various risk factors are associated with the occurrence of interstitial pneumopathy, including the presence of anti-topoisomerase I antibodies (Scl-70) and the diffuse skin form of systemic scleroderma.

bt_tgt: Rhabdomyolyse: early onset of care.

src: Rhabdomyolysis is defined by myalgia, potentially painful myoedema and muscular weakness due to death of muscular fiber in the striated muscle.
tgt: La rhabdomyolyse est définie par une myalgie, un myxœdème potentiellement douloureux et une faiblesse musculaire due à la dégradation de la fibre musculaire dans le muscle strié.
bt_tgt: Rhabdomyolyse is defined by myalgia, a potentially painful myxodema and muscle weakness due to the breakdown of muscle fiber in striated muscle.

src: Frequent etiologies include physical effort, intoxication (alcohol, drugs and medication) and physical trauma.
tgt: Les étiologies fréquentes comprennent l’effort physique, l’intoxication (alcool, drogues et médicaments) et les traumatismes physiques.
bt_tgt: Common etiologies include physical exertion, intoxication (alcohol, drugs and drugs) and physical trauma.

src: Diagnosis relies on creatine kinase (CK) levels.
tgt: Le diagnostic repose sur les niveaux de créatine kinase (CK).
bt_tgt: The diagnosis is based on the levels of creatine kinase (CK).

src: The clinical spectrum of rhabdomyolysis includes an asymptomatic increased amount of CK as well as severe, life threatening complications such as acute renal failure and electrolyte disorders.
tgt: Le spectre clinique de la rhabdomyolyse comprend une augmentation asymptomatique du taux de CK ainsi que des complications graves, mettant en jeu le pronostic vital, telles que l'insuffisance rénale aiguë et les troubles électrolytiques.
bt_tgt: The clinical spectrum of rhabdomyolysis includes an asymptomatic increase in the rate of CK as well as serious complications, which play a vital role in prognosis, such as acute renal failure and electrolyte disorders.

src: Treatment is based on prevention and addressing complications.
tgt: Le traitement est basé sur la prévention et le traitement des complications.
bt_tgt: Treatment is based on the prevention and treatment of complications.

src: Efficacy of macro-clips for perforations and fistulas following endoscopic or surgical procedures. Retrospective analysis of 25 consecutive cases
tgt: Efficacité des macro clips pour les perforations et les fistules à la suite d'interventions endoscopiques ou chirurgicales. Analyse rétrospective de 25 cas consécutifs
bt_tgt: The effectiveness of macro clips for perforations and fistulas following endoscopic or surgical procedures.

src: The aim of our retrospective study is to analyse the results of endoscopic macro-clips used for closing intestinal breaches in the real life.
tgt: L'objectif de notre étude rétrospective est d'analyser les résultats des macro clips endoscopiques utilisés pour fermer les brèches intestinales dans la vie réelle.
bt_tgt: The purpose of our retrospective study is to analyze the results of the endoscopic macro clips used to close the intestinal fissures in real life.

src: Our results confirm the high efficiency of macro-clips in the treatment of endoscopic breaches in a regional hospital center.
tgt: Nos résultats confirment la grande efficacité des macro clips dans le traitement des brèches endoscopiques dans un centre hospitalier régional.
bt_tgt: Our results confirm the high effectiveness of macro clips in the treatment of endoscopic fractures in a regional hospital center.

src: Post-endoscopic, spontaneous perforations and surgical fistulas are included.
tgt: Les perforations post-endoscopiques spontanées et les fistules chirurgicales sont incluses.
bt_tgt: Spontaneous post-endoscopic perforations and surgical fistulas are included.

src: Our results are compared with principal published series.
tgt: Nos résultats sont comparés aux principales séries publiées.
bt_tgt: Our results are compared to the main series published.

src: Between 2010 and 2015, 25 consecutive patients underwent an endoscopic suture with macro-clips to seal a breach resulting from endoscopic perforation, surgical fistula, invasive medical procedure or spontaneous perforation.
tgt: Entre 2010 et 2015, 25 patients consécutifs ont subi une suture endoscopique avec des macro clips pour sceller une brèche résultant d'une perforation endoscopique, d'une fistule chirurgicale, d'un acte médical invasif ou d'une perforation spontanée.
bt_tgt: Between 2010 and 2015, 25 consecutive patients underwent an endoscopic suture with macro clips to seal a rupture resulting from an endoscopic perforation, surgical fistula, invasive medical action or spontaneous perforation.

src: The endoscopic efficacy was immediate for all patients whose perforation was of endoscopic aetiology.
tgt: L'efficacité endoscopique a été immédiate pour tous les patients dont la perforation était d'étiologie endoscopique.
bt_tgt: Endoscopic efficacy was immediately demonstrated for all patients whose perforation was endoscopic.

src: None of them required surgery.
tgt: Aucun d'entre eux n'a nécessité d'intervention chirurgicale.
bt_tgt: None of them require surgery.

src: Secondary complementary endoscopic treatment was only used in 6/25 patients.
tgt: Le traitement endoscopique complémentaire secondaire n'a été utilisé que chez 6 patients sur 25.
bt_tgt: Secondary complementary endoscopic treatment has only been used in 6 out of 25 patients.

src: All of them had non-endoscopic aetiology for their perforation.
tgt: Tous avaient une étiologie non endoscopique pour leur perforation.
bt_tgt: All had a non-endoscopic etiology for their perforation.

src: The survival at 1 month was 84 % and at 3 months of 76 %.
tgt: La survie à 1 mois était de 84 % et à 3 mois de 76 %.
bt_tgt: 1-month survival was 84% and 3-month survival was 76%.

src: The use of macro-clips seems less convincing for the closure of some postoperative fistula.
tgt: L'utilisation de macro-clips semble moins convaincante pour la fermeture de certaines fistules postopératoires.
bt_tgt: The use of macro-clips seems less convincing for the closure of certain postoperative fistulas.

src: The suture with macro-clips associated with endoscopic and medical treatments allowed to avoid surgical redo in some cases.
tgt: La suture avec des macro-clips associée à des traitements endoscopiques et médicaux a permis d'éviter une reprise chirurgicale dans certains cas.
bt_tgt: The sewing with macro-clips associated with endoscopic and medical treatments has allowed to avoid a surgical recovery in some cases.

src: However, these drugs are administered via intravitreal injections that are associated with sight-threatening complications.
tgt: 但是，这些药物通过玻璃体内注射给药，与损害视力的并发症有关。

errors_tgt.term: 与损害视力的并发症有关。

bt_tgt: However, these drugs are administered through a glass tube, and have been linked to complications of vision impairment.

src: As such, there has been great interest in developing sustained delivery platforms for anti-VEGF agents to the posterior segment of the eye.
tgt: 因此，人们对持续开发向眼后段输送抗-VEGF 药物的平台产生了浓厚的兴趣。

errors_tgt.term: 持续开发向眼后段输送抗-VEGF 药物的平台

bt_tgt: As a result, there has been a growing interest in the continuous development of a platform for anti-VEGF drugs to be delivered to the retina.

src: The characteristics of an ideal sustained delivery platform will then be discussed.
tgt: 然后将讨论理想型持续性递送平台的特征。
bt_tgt: Then we will discuss the characteristics of the ideal sustainable delivery platform.

src: Finally, the current available strategies will be analysed with the above-mentioned characteristics in mind to determine the advantages and disadvantages of each sustained drug delivery modality.
tgt: 最后，将在分析现有战略时考虑到上述特征，以确定每种持续性药物输送方式的优缺点。

errors_tgt.term: 在分析现有战略时考虑到上述特征

bt_tgt: Finally, the above features will be taken into account when analyzing existing strategies to determine the advantages and disadvantages of each sustained drug delivery method.

src: Anti-vascular endothelial growth factors (anti-VEGF) have become the most common treatment modality for many retinal diseases.
tgt: 抗血管内皮生长因子（抗-VEGF）已成为许多视网膜疾病最常见的治疗方式。
bt_tgt: Anti-VEGF (anti-vascular endogenous growth factor) has become the most common treatment for many diseases of the retina.

src: These include neovascular age-related macular degeneration (n-AMD), proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR) and retinal vein occlusions (RVO).
tgt: 这些疾病包括新生血管性年龄相关性黄斑变性 (n-AMD)、增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变 (PDR) 与视网膜静脉阻塞 (RVO)。
bt_tgt: These include age-related amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (n-AMD), proliferative diabetic retinal disease (PDR) and retinal vein obstruction (RVO).

src: The most feared of these complications is endophthalmitis, a severe infection of the eye with extremely poor visual outcomes.
tgt: 这些并发症中最可怕的是眼内炎，这是一种严重的眼部感染，会造成视力严重低下。
bt_tgt: The most terrible of these complications is inflammation of the eye, a serious eye infection that can cause severe vision loss.

src: Patients with retinal diseases typically have to undergo multiple injections before achieving the desired therapeutic effect.
tgt: 患有视网膜疾病的患者通常必须进行多次注射才能达到预期的治疗效果。
bt_tgt: Patients with retinal disease usually have to undergo multiple injections to achieve the desired therapeutic effect.

src: Each injection incurs the risk of the sight-threatening complications.
tgt: 每次注射都会产生风险，此类风险会出现危及视力的并发症。
bt_tgt: Each injection carries a risk of developing vision-damaging complications.

src: In recent years, there have been various strategies that have been conceptualised.
tgt: 近年来，已经出现了各种概念化的策略。
bt_tgt: In recent years, various conceptual strategies have emerged.

src: These include non-biodegradable implants, nano-formulations and hydrogels.
tgt: 这包括不可生物降解的植入物、纳米配方和水凝胶。
bt_tgt: This includes non-biodegradable plants, nanoparticles, and hydrogel.

src: In this review, the barriers of drug delivery to the posterior segment of the eye will be explained.
tgt: 本综述将阐释药物输送至眼后段所面临的障碍。
bt_tgt: This review will explain the obstacles to the delivery of the drug to the retina of the eye.

src: Through the above, this review attempts to provide an overview of the sustained delivery platforms in their various phases of development.
tgt: 通过上述内容，本综述试图提供持续性输送平台在各个开发阶段的概览。
bt_tgt: Through the above, this overview attempts to provide an overview of the continuous delivery platforms at each development stage.

src: Digital prosthodontic technology has brought great changes to the prosthodontic technology in China by improving the quality of prostheses, adding new types of restorations, changing the manufacturing methods of restorations from handmade to computer-aided manufacturing, bringing new operating models of dental laboratories, and promoting the academic status of the prosthodontic technology.
tgt: 数字化修复技术提高修复体质量，增加新的修复体类型，将修复体制造方式从手工制造转变为计算机辅助制造，引入全新的口腔实验室的操作模式及巩固修复技术的学术地位，给中国的修复技术带来巨变。
bt_tgt: Digitalised repair technology improves the quality of repaired bodies, adds new types of repaired bodies, transforms repair systems from manual to computer-aided manufacturing, introduces a whole new operating model for oral laboratories and consolidates the academic status of repair technology, which has brought a huge change to China's repair technology.

src: The current phenomenological study examined, through the eyes of immigrant parents, how they comprehend their children's involvement in delinquent behavior.
tgt: 通过移民父母的视角，目前的现象学研究研究了他们如何理解孩子参与违法行为。

errors_tgt.term: 如何理解孩子参与违法行为

bt_tgt: From the perspective of immigrant parents, current phenomenological studies have examined how they understand children's involvement in illegal behavior.

src: This study examined in-depth semistructured interviews conducted with fourteen immigrant parents (10 mothers and 4 fathers) from the former Soviet Union in Israel of children treated in rehabilitation facilities for delinquent youth.
tgt: 这项研究调查了 14 名在以色列的前苏联移民父母（10 位母亲和 4 位父亲），以对在犯罪青年康复机构接受治疗的儿童进行深入的半结构化访谈。
bt_tgt: The study surveyed 14 parents of former Soviet immigrants in Israel (mothers 10 and fathers 4) to conduct in-depth semi-structured interviews with children receiving treatment in a criminal youth rehabilitation facility.

src: Data analysis revealed a gradual decline in children's behavior ascribed to the developmental stage of adolescence, the pressures of immigration, and cultural conflict.
tgt: 数据分析显示，由于青春期发育阶段、移民压力和文化冲突，使得儿童的行为逐渐下降。

errors_tgt.term: 使得儿童的行为逐渐下降

bt_tgt: Data analysis shows that due to the developmental stage of adolescence, immigration pressures and cultural conflicts, children's behavior is gradually declining.

src: These three factors are interwoven together to create a fabric within which they see their children turning to crime.
tgt: 这三个因素交织在一起，形成了一种结构，他们看到自己的孩子在该结构中走向犯罪。

errors_tgt.term: 形成了一种结构，他们看到自己的孩子在该结构中走向犯罪

bt_tgt: These three factors are intertwined, forming a structure, in which they see their children committing crimes.

src: Parents' gradual loss of control is balanced by attempts to idealize the parent-child relationship and to minimize the severity of the offenses committed.
tgt: 在父母逐渐失去控制的平衡中，他们试图将父母与子女的关系理想化，并尽量减少罪行的严重程度。

errors_tgt.term: 在父母逐渐失去控制的平衡中

bt_tgt: In a balance that parents are losing control over, they try to idealize the parent-child relationship and try to reduce the severity of the crime as much as possible.

src: They describe various differing and even contradictory experiences of themselves as parents and their struggles to piece together incohesive, alternating experiences of themselves as parents.
tgt: 他们描述了自己作为父母的各种不同甚至矛盾的经历，以及他们如何努力将自己作为父母没有凝聚力、交替的经历拼凑起来。

errors_tgt.term: 他们如何努力将自己作为父母没有凝聚力、交替的经历拼凑起来

bt_tgt: They describe their various and even contradictory experiences as parents, and how they struggled to put together their experiences as parents without the cohesion and alternation.

src: This study examined in-depth semistructured interviews conducted with fourteen immigrant parents (10 mothers and 4 fathers) from the former Soviet Union in Israel of children treated in rehabilitation facilities for delinquent youth.
tgt: 这项研究调查了 14 名在以色列的前苏联移民父母（10 位母亲和 4 位父亲），以对在犯罪青年康复机构接受治疗的儿童进行深入的半结构化访谈。
bt_tgt: The study surveyed 14 parents of former Soviet immigrants in Israel (mothers 10 and fathers 4) to conduct in-depth semi-structured interviews with children receiving treatment in a criminal youth rehabilitation facility.

src: Despite the critical role they can play in their children's rehabilitation, as well as the distress that they themselves experience, parents of children involved in delinquent behavior have often been ignored in research.
tgt: 尽管他们可以在孩子的康复过程中发挥关键作用，而且他们自己也经历过痛苦，但在研究中，参与违法行为孩子的父母常常被忽视。
bt_tgt: Although they may play a critical role in the child's recovery process, and they themselves have experienced pain, in studies, parents who engage in child abuse are often overlooked.

src: Scarce qualitative literature has focused on understanding the perspective of parents of adolescents involved in crime, and no prior literature has examined how the status of being a parent of an adolescent who is involved in delinquency intersects with being an immigrant parent.
tgt: 很少有定性文献侧重于理解参与犯罪的青少年父母的观点，并且之前没有文献研究过参与犯罪的青少年父母的地位与移民父母地位之间的关系。
bt_tgt: Few qualitative literature focuses on understanding the views of teenage parents who are involved in crime, and no previous literature has studied the relationship between the status of teenage parents who are involved in crime and the status of immigrant parents

src: There has been a sharp rise of reported handheld laser-induced maculopathy (HLIM) cases over the past decade, a concerning trend that may continue due to unregulated online access to high power lasers.
tgt: 据报道，过去十年中，手持式激光诱导性黄斑病变 (HLIM) 病例急剧上升，由于不受监管的高功率激光器在线访问，这一令人担忧的趋势可能会持续下去。

errors_tgt.term: 不受监管的高功率激光器在线访问

bt_tgt: In the past decade, the number of cases of handheld laser-induced yellow fever (HLIM) cases has reportedly increased dramatically, and this worrying trend may continue due to unregulated high-power laser online access.

src: Though HLIM has distinct clinical features, not uncommonly it may masquerade as other retinal disorders.
tgt: 尽管 HLIM 具有明显的临床特征，但它可能掩饰为其他视网膜疾病。
bt_tgt: Although HLIM has obvious clinical features, it may disguise other diseases of the retina.

src: It is critical therefore to recognise the clinical and multimodal imaging characteristics of this important and potentially devastating condition.
tgt: 因此，认识到这种重要且具潜在破坏性疾病的临床和多模式成像特征至关重要。

errors_tgt.term: 认识到这种重要且具潜在破坏性疾病的临床和多模式成像特征至关重要

bt_tgt: It is therefore essential to recognize the clinical and multi-mode imaging characteristics of this important and potentially devastating disease.

src: In addition, we present a unique case of HLIM, resembling the presentation of a placoid disease variant and illustrating choroidal ischaemia using advanced retinal imaging, that offers further insight into the mechanisms of laser injury and its complications.
tgt: 此外，我们提出了一个独特的 HLIM 病例，类似于 placoid 疾病变异的呈现，并使用先进的视网膜成像说明脉络膜缺血，从而进一步了解激光损伤的机制及其并发症。
bt_tgt: In addition, we have proposed a unique HLIM case, similar to the presentation of placoid disease variants, and using advanced retinal imaging to illustrate pulmonary embolism, thereby further understanding the mechanism of laser damage and its complications.

src: The issues addressed in this review aim to increase recognition of an increasingly important and trending condition with potentially profound visual complications.
tgt: 本综述涉及的问题旨在提高人们对这一日益重要的、具有潜在深远视觉并发症的趋势性疾病的认识。
bt_tgt: The question involved in this review is intended to raise awareness of the increasingly important, potentially progressive vision complications of this trendy disease.

src: As HLIM patients are typically young, unique issues need to be considered, such as delayed presentation, difficult history, poor compliance and behavioural or psychiatric comorbidity.
tgt: 由于 HLIM 患者通常是年轻人，因此需要考虑独特的问题，例如延迟就诊、病史困难、依从性差以及行为或精神合并症。
bt_tgt: Since HLIM patients are usually young, it is necessary to consider specific issues such as delayed diagnosis, difficulty in medical history, sexual dysfunction, and behavioral or psychiatric syndrome.

src: This article will review the clinical and diagnostic features of laser injury, with a special emphasis on the multimodal retinal findings.
tgt: 本文将回顾激光损伤的临床和诊断特征，特别强调多模态视网膜的发现。
bt_tgt: This article will review the clinical and diagnostic features of laser damage, with particular emphasis on the discovery of polymorphic retinas.

src: A meta-analysis of 2530 eyes from 48 real-world studies of therapies for macular oedema secondary to BRVO was conducted.
tgt: 对 48 项来自真实世界的关于 BRVO 继发性黄斑水肿治疗研究中的 2530 只眼睛进行了荟萃分析。
bt_tgt: Only 2530 of the 48 eye samples from the real-world BRVO retinal haemorrhage treatment study were analyzed.

src: Baseline characteristics, visual, anatomical and safety outcomes were recorded.
tgt: 记录基线特征、视力、解剖学与安全结果。
bt_tgt: Record the baseline characteristics, vision, anatomy and safety results

src: Visual and anatomical gains achieved in the real-world for anti-VEGF therapy were not as impressive as seminal RCTs, possibly due to reduced injection frequency in the real world and differences in baseline characteristics.
tgt: 在真实世界中，抗 VEGF 治疗在视觉和解剖学领域所获的成果不如开创性的 RCT 一般令人印象深刻，这可能是由于真实世界中注射频率有所减少且基线特征存在差异。
bt_tgt: In the real world, the results of anti-VEGF therapy in the field of vision and anatomy are generally less impressive than pioneering RCTs, which may be due to the reduced frequency of injections in the real world and differences in baseline characteristics.

src: This review assessed the real-world evidence of the management of macular oedema secondary to branch retinal vein occlusion (BRVO).
tgt: 本综述评估了视网膜分支静脉阻塞 (BRVO) 继发黄斑水肿治疗的真实依据。
bt_tgt: This review evaluates the true basis for treatment of branched vein obstruction (BRVO) following yellow spot vein thrombosis.

src: The weighted mean and weighted estimates from random-effects models were calculated for visual acuity (VA) and central subfield thickness (CST) changes at 6, 12 and 24 months.
tgt: 计算了随机效应模型的加权平均值与加权估计值，以显示 6 个月、12 个月和 24 个月时的视敏度 (VA) 与中央视网膜厚度 (CST) 的变化。
bt_tgt: Calculates the weighted average and weighted estimate of the random effect model to show the change in visual sensitivity (VA) and central retinal thickness (CST) over 6 months, 12 months and 24 months.

src: Primary outcome was change in VA (logMAR letters) at 12 months.
tgt: 主要结果为 12 个月时 VA（logMAR 字母） 的变化。
bt_tgt: The main result was a change in the letter VA (logMAR) at 12 months.

src: Study quality was assessed using the quality appraisal checklist for case series developed by Institute of Health Economics.
tgt: 使用健康经济学研究所为系列病例开发的质量评估清单评估研究质量。
bt_tgt: Using the Institute of Health Economics to develop a series of case-control quality assessment lists to evaluate the quality of research.

src: The mean baseline VA for the pooled data was 54.0 (51.5, 56.5) letters and the mean baseline CST was 501.3 (483.5, 519.1) µm.
tgt: 汇总数据的平均基线 VA 为 54.0 (51.5，56.5) 个字母，平均基线 CST 为 501.3 (483.5，519.1) 微米。
bt_tgt: The average baseline VA of the aggregate data is 54.0 (51.5,56.5) characters, the average baseline CST is 501.3 (483.5,519.1) μm

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. src: In this review we focused on some of these elements such as the available biomarkers, the role of enhanced transurethral resection of the bladder and the role of the molecular classification in defining prognosis and therapeutic approaches in bladder cancer patients.

src: Finally, the molecular classification of the bladder cancer represents one of the most exciting novelty in this field, improving consistently the knowledge of bladder cancer.

src: Transurethral resection of the bladder represents a fundamental diagnostic and therapeutic step in the management of bladder cancer and these techniques can successfully improve its outcomes.

tgt: Objetivo: explorar la relación entre los hábitos alimentarios y el cumplimiento de las pautas sobre el tiempo frente a la pantalla en niños españoles en edad escolar.
bt_tgt: Objective: to explore the relationship between eating habits and the compliance of the guidelines on screen time in Spanish school-age children.
